h:
这是一个 ComfyUI 工作流程，包括加载检查点、加载 LORA、使用直接扩散或额外的 SDXL Lightning LORA 进行快速/测试图片，以及 5 种不同类型的放大器的可选选择；像素空间、迭代、Ultimate SD、SUPIR 和 SUPIR 加上额外的 Ultimate SD 步骤，最高可达 8 倍。在提示中，您可以打开或关闭在积极提示中添加 Pony 标签。

您将需要加载额外的自定义节点，包括 rg Three、KJN、SUPIR、Impact、UltimateSD、Primere。我建议新初学者从 git 安装 ComfyUI Manager 和 rg Three，然后启动 ComfyUI，加载此工作流程，并使用 ComfyUI Manager 安装其他缺少的节点和模型。从命令行，您还可以使用 rg Three 文件夹中的 __update_comfy__.py 脚本来使所有内容与 git 保持最新，或者使用 GUI 中的 ComfyUI Manager。该脚本将更新 ComfyUI 和所有自定义节点。

我有一个 RTX3090，因此图块编码器/解码器大小设置得更大，因为该卡中有一堆 vram - 如果您的硬件规格较低，您可能需要将其放下。

非常感谢 rg Three 和参与社区创建和维护自定义节点的其他人员

o.en:
This is a ComfyUI workflow that includes loading a checkpoint, loading LORAs, diffusion with either straight or additionally the SDXL Lightning LORA for fast/test pics, and the optional selection of 5 different kinds of upscalers; pixel space, iterative, Ultimate SD, SUPIR, and SUPIR plus an additional Ultimate SD step to get up to 8x. In prompting you can toggle on or off the addition of Pony tags to your positive prompt.

You will need to load in extra custom nodes including rgthree, KJN, SUPIR, Impact, UltimateSD, Primere off the top of my head. I recommend for new starters to install ComfyUI Manager and rgthree from git, then fire up ComfyUI, load this workflow, and use ComfyUI Manager to install the other missing nodes and models. From the command line you can also use the __update_comfy__.py script in the rgthree folder to keep everything up to date with git, or use ComfyUI Manager from the gui. The script will update ComfyUI and all your custom nodes.

I have a RTX3090 and so the tile encoder/decoder sizes are set larger as there's stacks of vram in that card - you might want to drop it down if your hardware is lower spec.

Many thanks to rgthree and the other people involved in the community creating and maintaining custom nodes
